description.sub_ename: THE INTRODUCTION OF ASSEMBLY AND TESTING PRACTICE OF SEMICOND
description.describe_ch: 透過半導體封測之產品、製程與廠務系統實務，建立理論知識與實務之連結，並安排產線參訪，實地驗證課程所學，建構未來就業基礎。
description.describe_eh: Through the practical knowledge/experience of semiconductor packaging and testing products, processes, and factory systems, establish a connection between theoretical knowledge and practice. And arrange production line visits for field observations, and build future employment foundations.

targets.describe_ch: 結合ESG概念認識封測廠廠務系
targets.describe_en: Understand the factory management system of the packaging and testing plant base on the ESG concept
